cases.sentence: ___ о возможности иметь детей был давно спорный и раздражавший ее.
cases.translation: The question of whether they could have children had long been contentious and irritating to her.
cases.explain: Вопрос is the subject of «был» (was), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Отпив несколько ___, она взглянула на него и по выражению его лица ясно поняла, что ему противны были ее рука и жест.
cases.translation: Having taken a few sips, she glanced at him and clearly understood from his expression that her hand and gesture disgusted him.
cases.explain: The quantifying word несколько (a few) governs the genitive plural, giving глотков (sips).

cases.sentence: Она подняла чашку, отставив мизинец, и поднесла ее ко ___.
cases.translation: She raised her cup, her little finger extended, and brought it to her mouth.
cases.explain: The preposition ко (to/toward, form of к) governs the dative case, giving рту (mouth).

cases.sentence: Вронский воротил ___ и велел принесть депешу.
cases.translation: Vronsky called the valet back and told him to bring the dispatch.
cases.explain: Коммердинера is the direct object of the transitive verb воротил (called back); as an animate noun its accusative form matches the genitive.

cases.sentence: Она стояла в своей комнате над открытым ___, отбирая вещи, когда он вошел к ней.
cases.translation: She stood in her room over an open trunk, sorting through her things, when he came in to her.
cases.explain: The preposition над (above) governs the instrumental case, giving сундуком (trunk).

cases.sentence: Она стояла в своей ___ над открытым сундуком, отбирая вещи.
cases.translation: She stood in her room over an open trunk, sorting through her things.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) denoting location governs the prepositional case, giving комнате.

reading.ru: Чувствуя, что примирение было полное, Анна с утра оживленно принялась за приготовление к отъезду.
reading.question: How did Anna spend the morning at the start of the chapter?
options: Busily preparing for departure, feeling the reconciliation was complete
Packing to leave forever without Vronsky
reading.correct: Busily preparing for departure, feeling the reconciliation was complete
reading.explain: The text says that, feeling the reconciliation was complete, Anna set about preparing for departure with animation.

reading.ru: «Я сейчас съезжу к маман, она может прислать мне деньги через Егорова, и завтра я готов ехать», — сказал он.
reading.question: What did Vronsky say he would do before they could leave?
options: Visit his mother to get money through Yegorov
reading.correct: Visit his mother to get money through Yegorov
reading.explain: Vronsky says he will go to his mother's, who can send him money through Yegorov, and then he will be ready to leave.

reading.ru: «Ты не поверишь, как мне опостылили эти комнаты», — сказала она, садясь подли него к своему кофею.
reading.question: What did Anna say she was sick of?
reading.correct: These furnished rooms
reading.explain: Anna says she can't believe how sick she is of these rooms.

reading.ru: Я думаю о Воздвиженском, как об обетованной земле.
reading.question: How did Anna describe Vozdvizhenskoye?
reading.correct: As a promised land
reading.explain: Anna says she thinks of Vozdvizhenskoye as a promised land.

reading.ru: Коммердинер Вронского пришел спросить расписку на телеграмму из Петербурга.
reading.question: What did Vronsky's valet come to ask about?
options: A receipt for a telegram from Petersburg
reading.correct: A receipt for a telegram from Petersburg
reading.explain: The text says the valet came to ask for a signature for a telegram from Petersburg.

reading.ru: Какая же может быть тайна между Стивой и мной?» Вронский воротил коммердинера и велел принесть депешу.
reading.question: What did Anna demand to know about the telegram?
options: What secret there could be between her and Stiva
reading.correct: What secret there could be between her and Stiva
reading.explain: Anna asks why he didn't show it to her, since there can be no secret between her and Stiva.

reading.ru: Да, но он пишет, ничего еще не мог добиться.
reading.question: What did Stiva's telegram say about the divorce?
options: He had not yet been able to achieve anything
reading.correct: He had not yet been able to achieve anything
reading.explain: The telegram says Stiva has not yet managed to accomplish anything regarding the divorce.

reading.ru: «Надежды мало, но я сделаю все возможное и невозможное».
reading.question: What did Stiva promise in the telegram, despite little hope?
options: To do everything possible and impossible
reading.correct: To do everything possible and impossible
reading.explain: The telegram ends with Stiva promising to do everything possible and impossible.

reading.ru: «Кажется, что он выиграл с Певцова все и даже больше того, что тот может заплатить — около шестидесяти тысяч».
reading.question: How much had Yashvin reportedly won from Pevtsov?
reading.correct: About sixty thousand
reading.explain: Vronsky says Yashvin won everything from Pevtsov and more than he could pay, about sixty thousand.

reading.ru: «Для чего ты желаешь этого?» «Боже мой, опять о любви», — подумал он, морщась.
reading.question: What did Vronsky think, wincing, when Anna pressed him about love?
reading.correct: "My God, love again"
reading.explain: The text says he thought, wincing, "My God, love again."

reading.ru: Вопрос о возможности иметь детей был давно спорный и раздражавший ее.
reading.question: What long-standing point of contention is mentioned between Anna and Vronsky?
reading.correct: The question of having children
reading.explain: The text says the question of the possibility of having children had long been a point of dispute that irritated her.

reading.ru: Она подняла чашку, отставив мизинец, и поднесла ее ко рту.
reading.question: What small gesture of Anna's irritated Vronsky?
options: Lifting her cup with her little finger extended
reading.correct: Lifting her cup with her little finger extended
reading.explain: The text says she raised her cup with her little finger extended, and he found the hand, gesture, and sound of her sipping distasteful.

reading.ru: «Женщина, которая не угадала сердцем, в чем лежат счастье и честь ее сына, у той женщины нет сердца».
reading.question: What did Anna say about a woman who fails to understand her son's happiness and honor?
options: That such a woman has no heart
That such a woman is very wise
That she loved Vronsky too much
reading.correct: That such a woman has no heart
reading.explain: Anna says a woman who did not sense with her heart where her son's happiness and honor lay has no heart.

reading.ru: Эти, точно такие же ласки он расточал и будет, и хочет расточать другим женщинам, думала она.
reading.question: What dark thought did Anna have about Vronsky's tenderness?
options: That he lavished, and would lavish, the same caresses on other women
That he no longer loved her at all
That he was planning to leave the country
reading.correct: That he lavished, and would lavish, the same caresses on other women
reading.explain: The text says she thought these very caresses he had lavished, and would want to lavish, on other women.

reading.ru: Зачем, когда в душе у нее была буря, и она чувствовала, что стоит на повороте жизни, который может иметь ужасные последствия, зачем ей в эту минуту надо было притворяться пред чужим человеком, который рано или поздно узнает же все?
reading.question: Why did Anna feel she had to pretend in front of Yashvin?
options: Because she felt she was at a turning point in her life, with a storm in her soul
Because Yashvin was a close friend
Because she wanted to impress him
reading.correct: Because she felt she was at a turning point in her life, with a storm in her soul
reading.explain: The text says there was a storm in her soul and she felt she stood at a turning point in her life that could have terrible consequences.

reading.ru: Кажется, что я не получу всего, а в Середу надо ехать.
reading.question: What did Yashvin say about the debt owed to him?
options: He probably wouldn't get all of it, and had to leave on Wednesday
He had already been paid in full
He would sue for the money
He didn't care about the money
reading.correct: He probably wouldn't get all of it, and had to leave on Wednesday
reading.explain: Yashvin says it seems he won't get everything, and he has to leave on Wednesday.

reading.ru: «Ведь мое все состояние тут», — он показал на боковой карман.
reading.question: Where did Yashvin say his entire fortune was?
reading.correct: In his side pocket
reading.explain: Yashvin says his whole fortune is right there and points to his side pocket.

reading.ru: Она хотела сказать «Гельсингфорс», но не хотела сказать слово, сказанное Вронским.
reading.question: What word did Anna avoid saying, even though she wanted to?
reading.correct: "Helsingfors"
reading.explain: The text says she wanted to say "Helsingfors" but did not want to say the word that Vronsky had spoken.

reading.ru: «Что вам надо?» — спросила она его по-французски.
reading.question: In what language did Anna ask Vronsky what he wanted?
reading.correct: French
reading.explain: The text says she asked him in French, "What do you want?"

reading.ru: Выходя он в зеркало, увидал ее лицо, бледное, с дрожащими губами.
reading.question: What did Vronsky see reflected in the mirror as he was leaving?
options: Her pale face with trembling lips
reading.correct: Her pale face with trembling lips
reading.explain: The text says as he was leaving, he saw in the mirror her face, pale, with trembling lips.

reading.ru: Целый этот день он провел вне дома, и когда приехал поздно вечером, девушка сказала ему, что у Анны Аркадьевны болит голова, и она просила не входить к ней.
reading.question: How does the chapter end?
options: Vronsky returns late and is told Anna has a headache and asked not to be disturbed
Anna leaves for the countryside alone
reading.correct: Vronsky returns late and is told Anna has a headache and asked not to be disturbed
reading.explain: The final sentence says that when he arrived late in the evening, the maid told him Anna Arkadyevna had a headache and asked him not to come in.

highlight.question: Which sentence demonstrates that Anna was now indifferent to whether they left a day earlier or later?
sentences: Чувствуя, что примирение было полное, Анна с утра оживленно принялась за приготовление к отъезду.

Хотя и не было решено, едут ли они в понедельник, или во вторник, так как оба вчера уступали один другому, Анна деятельно приготавливалась к отъезду, чувствуя себя теперь совершенно равнодушной к тому, что они уедут днем раньше или позже.
Она стояла в своей комнате над открытым сундуком, отбирая вещи, когда он, уже одетый, раньше обыкновенного вошел к ней.
highlight.explain: This sentence explicitly states that Anna felt completely indifferent about the exact departure date.

highlight.question: Which sentence shows Anna instructing someone to go to the dining room and wait for her?
sentences: – Нет, я и сама не успею, – сказала она и тотчас же подумала: – «Стало быть, можно было устроиться так, чтобы сделать, как я хотела».
– Нет, как ты хотел, так и делай.
Иди в столовую, я сейчас приду, только отобрать эти ненужные вещи, – сказала она, передавая на руку Аннушки, на которой уже лежала гора тряпок, еще что-то.
highlight.explain: This sentence contains her direction for the person to go to the dining room while she finishes selecting items.

highlight.question: Which sentence reveals Anna's suspicion that he is concealing his correspondence with other women from her?
sentences: – Я вчера сказала, что мне совершенно все равно, когда я получу и даже получу ли развод, – сказала она покраснев.
– Не было никакой надобности скрывать от меня.
«Так он может скрыть и скрывает от меня свою переписку с женщинами», – подумала она.
highlight.explain: This sentence expresses her worried realization that he can and does hide things from her.

highlight.question: Which sentence shows Anna recalling the passionate intimate moment of their reconciliation from the previous day?
sentences: Она не отвечала.
Пристально глядя на него, на его лицо, руки, она вспоминала со всеми подробностями сцену вчерашнего примирения и его страстные ласки.
«Эти, точно такие же ласки он расточал и будет и хочет расточать другим женщинам!»
– думала она.
highlight.explain: This sentence describes her detailed memory of their reconciliation scene and his passionate caresses.

highlight.question: Which sentences describe his philosophy of balancing romantic liaisons with other commitments?
sentences: – О господи!  сколько раз!
Но, понимаете, одному можно сесть за карты, но так, чтобы всегда встать, когда придет время rendez-vous.
А мне можно заниматься любовью, но так, чтобы вечером не опоздать к партии.
Так я и устраиваю.
highlight.explain: These sentences reveal how he manages his affairs by scheduling them around his other obligations.

highlight.question: Which sentence captures his sudden moment of compassion for her despite his self-justifying thoughts?
sentences: «Я ни в чем не виноват пред нею, – думал он.
– Если она хочет себя наказывать, tant pis pour elle».
Но, выходя, ему показалось, что она сказала что-то, и сердце его вдруг дрогнуло от состраданья к ней.
highlight.explain: This sentence shows his heart trembling with sympathy for her as he leaves, overcoming his defensive mindset.
